# Tottertop

> Tottertop is a one-tap physics stacking game for phones, now in development. A swaying crane drops blocks onto a wobbling tower; stack it as high as you can. One round takes about a minute.

Tottertop is a single-player mobile game by ipe() (https://ipe.rest/). It is in development and has NOT been released: no store page, release date or final price exists yet. This site is the game's home page.

## Key facts

- Simple physics stacking game, single player.
- One tap to play; a round lasts about one minute.
- Planned as free to play, supported by rewarded ads you choose to watch, with an optional purchase to remove ads.
- Planned for iOS and Android, in 11 languages.
- No release date yet.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tottertop.ipe.rest/): Tottertop is a quick physics game for your phone. A crane swings above a wobbling tower: tap once to drop the block and try to stack it so the tower stays balanced. One round takes about a minute.
- [Contact](https://tottertop.ipe.rest/contact/)

## Journal

RSS: https://tottertop.ipe.rest/journal/feed.xml

- [What Tottertop is, and why we are making it](https://tottertop.ipe.rest/journal/2026-11-10-what-tottertop-is/): A one-tap physics tower stacker: a crane drops blocks onto a wobbling tower, and one round takes about a minute. Why ipe() is making a game this small.

The journal is written in English and Korean only: https://tottertop.ipe.rest/journal/ and https://tottertop.ipe.rest/ko/journal/.

## Languages

The site is available in 11 languages (English and Korean are written by hand, the others are AI translations): English, 한국어, 日本語, 简体中文, Español, Français, Deutsch, Português, Русский, العربية, हिन्दी. Each language lives under /<code>/ (English at the root).
